conditional depende de condição que deve ser explicitada; background contextualiza;

o excerto, que deve ocorrer uma única vez no chunk. condition é texto apenas em
conditional. Para irrelevant use requirement_ids=[] e supporting_spans=[].

Prefira regras operacionais, incluindo tabelas, a títulos e objetivos.
Use sufficient só com cobertura de todos os requisitos e gaps=[]. Se houver
lacuna material, use retrieve, clarify ou abstain conforme a causa, nunca sufficient.

próximo menciona outro processo. Condições encontradas em fontes não são fatos

Autorização concreta com informação material ausente exige clarify.
Para lacuna recuperável use retrieve com UMA busca ou seção do catálogo disponível;
não invente IDs. Preserve as evidências já disponíveis. Sem suporte use abstain.
Só retrieve permite lookup; só clarify permite clarification; demais usam null.
Metadados indicam status, versão e autoridade, mas não concedem acesso. Não resolva
conflitos apenas pelo número de autoridade. Explique brevemente a decisão, sem
raciocínio privado e sem conhecimento externo.

result.question: Quais cuidados a política exige antes de compartilhar dados com um fornecedor externo?

baseline.question: Quais cuidados a política exige antes de compartilhar dados com um fornecedor externo?

claims.text: Antes de compartilhar dados confidenciais com um fornecedor externo, é necessário garantir que o destinatário esteja autorizado e que haja um propósito comercial aprovado para o compartilhamento, utilizando-se um mecanismo de transferência seguro ou plataforma controlada adequada à classificação da informação.
A classificação da informação determina as regras e controles mínimos para compartilhamento externo, como o uso de canais aprovados e controles de acesso limitados aos destinatários pretendidos.

O uso de dados de fornecedores em IA requer que a ferramenta e o caso de uso sejam aprovados, respeito à Política de Compartilhamento de Dados e de Segurança da Informação, e aprovações conforme a matriz de autoridade, especialmente para dados confidenciais, que necessitam aprovação adicional da Segurança da Informação e da Governança de IA.

Transmissão de informações confidenciais para terceiros autorizados deve ocorrer somente quando existir uma finalidade comercial legítima, o destinatário for autorizado e forem usados canais seguros aprovados.
O envio de informações confidenciais por email comum a fornecedores ou transportadoras não é um mecanismo aprovado, a menos que haja aprovação explícita e controles técnicos adequados.

4. Supplier disclosure

If confidential data was accidentally sent to a supplier or carrier, the employee must report the incident immediately. Information Security coordinates containment and determines whether Procurement, Legal, Privacy, the business owner, or the supplier must take additional action.

5. Supplier data

The fact that an AI product is procured does not mean confidential supplier or customer data may automatically be entered into it. Data classification and approved-use requirements remain applicable.

DATA SHARING POLICY

Document ID: DOC-005 | Version: 2.2 | Effective: 2026-01-01 | Status: ACTIVE | Domain: Information Security

4. Supplier data and approvals

Use of supplier data in AI requires an approved AI tool/use case, compliance with the Data Sharing Policy and Information Security Policy, and the approvals applicable to the data classification. Confidential supplier data additionally requires Information Security and AI Governance approval as defined by the Approval Authority Matrix.

1. Purpose

Define requirements for sharing enterprise information with external parties, including suppliers, logistics providers, professional services firms, and technology providers.

3. External transmission

Confidential customer information may be transmitted to an authorized external party only when there is a legitimate business purpose, the recipient is authorized, and an approved secure transfer mechanism or controlled platform is used.

4. Sharing with transportation carriers

Transportation carriers may receive only the information required to execute the contracted logistics service. Customer or shipment data classified as confidential must not be transmitted through ordinary unprotected email merely because the recipient is a contracted carrier.

6. Supplier and AI-related use

Where supplier or customer information is processed by an AI tool, the tool is treated as an external or managed processing environment according to its approval status. The AI Governance Policy and Information Security Policy apply in addition to this policy.

Classification | External sharing rule | Minimum channel/control
Public | May be shared when approved for public use. | Approved business channel.
Internal | Share only for legitimate business need. | Corporate-managed channel.
Confidential | Share only with an authorized recipient and approved business purpose. | Approved secure transfer or controlled platform; access limited to intended recipients.
Restricted | External sharing requires explicit authorization under the applicable security or legal control. | Approved restricted-data mechanism and documented authorization.

2. Procurement considerations

Procurement should identify the provider, commercial model, expected users, intended business use, data categories, integration requirements, support model, portability, termination provisions, and material subcontractors.

3. AI supplier due diligence

Commercial review should consider service commitments, data-processing terms, retention options, intellectual-property provisions, model or service changes, audit rights where applicable, and exit requirements.

6. Related documents

Information Security Policy; Data Sharing Policy; applicable supplier agreement.

2. Confidential information

Confidential information includes identifiable customer information, non-public supplier commercial information, credentials and authentication material, non-public contractual terms, sensitive operational data, and other information explicitly classified as confidential by the enterprise.

2. Scope

Applies to employees, contractors, systems, and business processes that disclose internal, confidential, customer, supplier, or operational information outside the enterprise.

Control | Requirement
Identity and access | Use enterprise-approved authentication and least-privilege access where supported.
Data handling | Input only data permitted for the approved tool, use case, and classification.
Provider terms | Approved processing and retention terms must be established where external providers process enterprise data.
Logging and traceability | Maintain usage or audit evidence when required by the risk classification or use case.
Secrets | Credentials, private keys, passwords, and equivalent authentication secrets must not be entered into general AI prompts.
Incident handling | Suspected exposure through an AI system must follow the Security Incident SOP.

Related documents

Data Sharing Policy; Document Governance Policy; Security Incident SOP; AI Security Standard; AI Governance Policy.

5. New AI tools

A new AI tool that processes enterprise or supplier data requires approval by the AI Governance Owner, with Information Security and Procurement review. Additional review may be required for legal, privacy, regulated, or high-impact use cases.

4. Contract analysis

Supplier contracts may be processed only in an approved AI environment authorized for the contract's information classification. Users must not assume that a consumer-accessible AI tool is approved for confidential contract content.
